summary: Strudel Module (Optical Disc Ripping) - All features tested and working. Backend: 13/13 API tests passed. Frontend: Page loads correctly with header, tool status badges, 4 tabs, drives panel, and legal notice. Sidebar entry present under Settings.

GET /api/strudel/config - Returns module configuration with defaults
